content: La bele koalia oin ida, hahalok oin seluk

Iha tempu nebaa ema rihun ba rihun mai sena malu atu rona Jesus nia hanorin. Jesus koalia uluk ba Nia eskolante sira dehan, “Kuidadu ho ema Farizeu sira. Tanba sira nee koalia oin ida, hahalok oin seluk. Sira nia hahalok nee hanesan fermentu, ema tau uitoan deit ba mos, trigu sae hotu.
Buat hotu-hotu nebee agora taka hela, loron ida sei nakloke. I buat hotu nebee agora subar hela, aban-bainrua ema sei hatene.
Buat nebee mak agora imi koalia sub-subar, loron ida ema sei rona mo-moos. I saida mak imi koalia bis-bisu iha kuartu laran, aban-bainrua ema sei foo sai ho lian makaas iha ema barak nia oin.”
Tauk mak Maromak deit
“Hau nia belun sira, la bele tauk ema nebee mak hakarak oho imi, tanba sira so bele oho deit imi nia isin, maibee la bele halo buat ida ba imi nia klamar.

Agora Hau foo hatene ba imi, see loos mak imi tenki tauk. Imi tenki tauk mak Maromak. Tanba Nia bele oho imi nia isin, depois Nia mos iha kbiit hodi soe imi nia klamar ba infernu. Nunee imi tenki tauk mak Nia.
Hanoin took manu liin. Manu liin lima, ema faan sentavus rua deit. Maski baratu liu, maibee manu ida deit mos Maromak la haluha.
Laos nee deit. Maibee Maromak mos hatene lo-loos imi nia fuuk lahan hira mak iha imi nia ulun. Nee duni lalika tauk, tanba imi folin boot liu manu liin barak.”
Keta moe foo sai katak ita tuir Nai Jesus

Jesus koalia nafatin ba Nia eskolante sira dehan, “Rona di-diak mai! See mak foo sai iha ema nia oin katak nia fiar mai Hau, aban-bainrua Hau, Ema Umanu nia Oan mos sei foo sai iha Maromak nia anju sira nia oin katak nia Hau nia ema.
Maibee see mak nega Hau iha ema nia oin, aban-bainrua Hau mos sei nega nia iha Maromak nia anju sira nia oin.
Ema nebee hatete aat Hau, Ema Umanu nia Oan, nia sei hetan perdaun. Maibee see mak hatete aat Espiritu Santu, Maromak la foo perdaun ba nia.
Aban-bainrua, kuandu ema lori imi baa hataan iha uma kreda ka iha ukun nain sira tanba imi fiar Hau, lalika preokupa kona ba oinsaa imi atu defende aan ka saida mak imi atu koalia.
Tanba iha oras nee duni Espiritu Santu sei hanorin imi, oinsaa mak imi atu hataan sira.”
Ema riku nebee beik-teen
Ema ida husi ema barak nee husu ba Jesus, “Mestri, hatete ba hau nia maun atu fahe ami nia aman matebian nia riku-soin ho hau.”
Jesus hataan, “Belun, see mak foti Hau atu tesi imi nain rua nia problema nee?”
Depois Jesus foo hanoin ba ema barak nee dehan, “Kuidadu! Matan moos, para imi nia matan la bele naklosu ba sasaan. Tanba ema nia moris la depende ba nia riku-soin.”
Tuir mai, Jesus halo komparasaun ida hanesan nee: “Iha ema riku ida hetan ai haan barak husi nia toos.
I nia hanoin dehan, ‘Hau nia armazen hodi tau ai haan nakonu hotu ona. Agora hau atu halo oinsaa tan?
Diak liu hau halo hanesan nee. Hau sobu tiha armazen tuan sira nee, i harii fali halo boot liu. Nunee hau bele rai ai haan sira nee hotu ho mos hau nia sasaan sel-seluk.
Depois hau hatete ba hau nia aan rasik: Hau moris diak ona! Buat hotu-hotu iha tiha ona, too hela ba tinan naruk nia laran. Agora deskansa ona ba, haan-hemu i goza ona ba.’
Maibee Maromak hatete ba nia, ‘Beik-teen! Kalan nee kedas Hau sei hasai o nia iis. Depois, see mak hetan sasaan bar-barak nebee o rai ba o nia aan nee?’”
Jesus hatutan tan dehan, “Nunee mos ho ema nebee halibur riku-soin ba nia aan rasik, maibee sai kiak iha Maromak nia oin tanba lakohi buka riku-soin lalehan nian.”
Keta preokupa ho imi nia moris
Depois Jesus hatete ba Nia eskolante sira dehan, “Tanba nee, Hau hatete ba imi, lalika preokupa ho imi nia moris loro-loron, atu haan saida, ka atu hatais saida.
Tanba ita nia moris folin liu hahaan, i ita nia isin lolon folin liu ropa.
Haree took manu metan sira. Manu sira nee la kuda batar, la silu batar, la iha armazen hodi haloot ai haan, maibee Maromak foo ai haan ba sira. Imi folin liu manu sira nee.
Se imi preokupa kona ba imi nia moris, nee bele aumenta imi nia tinan ka? Lae! Atu aumenta oras ida deit mos la bele.
Se buat kiikoan nee, imi la bele halo, nusaa mak imi hakarak preokupa ho buat sira seluk?

Haree took duut nebee funan iha rai fuik. Duut nia funan nee la halo servisu, la soru tais. Maibee Hau dehan ba imi, liurai Salomão, maski riku teb-tebes, nia hatais kapaas halo nusaa mos, duut funan sira nee kapaas liu nafatin.
Duut nebee ohin loron matak, aban ema soe fali ba ahi laran mos, Maromak halo furak. Saa tan imi! Nia sei foo ropa ba imi hatais. Entaun nusaa mak imi nia fiar fraku hanesan nee?!
Lalika hanoin barak kona ba haan-hemu.
Ema nebee la konhese Maromak, sira sempre buka tuun-sae buat sira nee. Maibee imi nia Aman iha lalehan hatene ona saida mak imi presiza.
Nee duni imi tenki hakaas aan atu serbi Maromak nudar imi nia Liurai mak Maromak sei foo tan buat sira nee ba imi.”
Rai riku-soin iha lalehan
Jesus koalia nafatin ba Nia eskolante sira dehan, “Lalika tauk! Imi ema uitoan deit, maibee imi nia Aman iha lalehan haksolok hili imi atu ukun hamutuk ho Nia.

Entaun, baa faan tiha sasaan nebee imi iha hodi fahe osan nee ba ema kiak sira. Nunee imi rai fali riku-soin iha lalehan, para bele dura. Iha nebaa, imi nia riku-soin sei la hotu, naok-teen la besik, i nehek mutin mos la estraga.
Tanba imi nia riku-soin tau iha nebee, imi nia laran mos iha nebaa.”
Ita tenki prontu loron-kalan atu simu Nai Jesus fila mai husi lalehan
“Imi tenki prontu serbi Maromak loron-kalan, hanesan atan nebee hatais hela ropa servisu nian i nia ahi-oan lakan hela deit.
Imi tenki sai hanesan atan sira nebee hadeer hein hela sira nia patraun fila husi festa kazamentu. Bainhira patraun fila i dere odamatan, sira baa loke kedas.
Kuandu patraun haree nia atan sira hein hela nia, sira sorti boot. Hau hatete lo-loos ba imi, patraun rasik sei haruka sira tuur, depois nia hatais fali ropa atan nian hodi serve nia atan sira nee.
Loos duni, atan sira nee sorti boot se sira nia patraun haree sira hein hela nia, maski nia fila iha kalan boot ka dadeer-saan nakukun.
Hanoin di-diak! Se iha uma nain ida hatene lo-loos tuku hira mak naok-teen atu mai, nia sei hadeer hodi hein atu naok-teen la bele tama.
Nunee mos, imi tenki prontu nafatin. Tanba aban-bainrua Hau, Ema Umanu nia Oan sei fila fali mai derepenti deit iha oras nebee imi la hatene.”
Atan diak ho atan aat
Pedro husu ba Jesus, “Nai, komparasaun ohin nee kona ba ami deit ka ba ema hotu?”

Nai Jesus hataan, “Komparasaun nee kona ba ema see deit mak hanesan atan diak ida, nia matenek toma konta nia patraun nia sasaan, i foo laran ba nia patraun. Patraun sei foo fiar ba ema nee atu fahe hahaan ba nia atan sira seluk tuir oras.
Bainhira patraun fila ba uma, haree atan nee badinas halao nia servisu, atan nee sorti boot.
Hau hatete lo-loos ba imi, patraun sei foti nia hodi toma konta nia riku-soin hotu.
Maibee karik atan nee hanoin dehan, ‘Patraun sei kleur mak fila’, depois nia komesa baku atan feto ho atan mane sira, i haan-hemu too lanu.

Se nunee, iha loron nebee nia la hein, i oras nebee nia la hatene, derepenti deit nia patraun fila mai. Patraun sei tetak rahun tiha atan nee i soe hamutuk ho ema sira nebee la halo tuir patraun nia hakarak.
Tanba atan nebee deit mak hatene patraun nia hakarak, maibee la prepara aan i la halo tuir, nia sei hetan kastigu todan.

Maibee atan nebee mak halo servisu la loos tanba la hatene patraun nia hakarak, nia sei simu kastigu kamaan. Tanba ema nebee simu barak ona, Maromak mos sei husu barak ba nia. I ema nebee simu knaar boot, nia responsabilidade mos boot.”
Ema sei kontra malu tanba Nai Jesus
Jesus koalia nafatin dehan, “Hau mai iha mundu nee atu sunu ahi. Ahi nee sei halo ema kontra malu. Tuir loos Hau hakarak atu ahi nee lakan ona.
Maibee Hau tenki simu terus todan lai, i Hau nia laran susar teb-tebes too terus nee hotu.
Imi hanoin Hau mai iha mundu nee para halo ema moris iha dame nia laran ka? Lae! Ema sei kontra malu tanba Hau.
Komesa agora, se iha uma kain ida iha ema nain lima, entaun nain tolu kontra rua, i nain rua kontra tolu.
Sira sei fahe malu: Aman kontra nia oan mane, oan mane kontra nia aman. Inan kontra nia oan feto, oan feto kontra nia inan. Banin feto kontra nia feto foun, feto foun kontra nia banin feto.”
Ema la kompriende buat nebee Nai Jesus halo
Depois Jesus hatete ba ema barak nee dehan, “Bainhira imi haree kalohan metan mosu iha loromonu, imi dehan, ‘Nee sinal hatudu katak, udan atu mai ona.’ I udan mai duni.
I kuandu anin boot mai husi rai fuik maran, imi dehan, ‘Orsida loro manas makaas.’ I sai nunee duni.
Imi nee matenek mamuk deit! Imi hatene siik sinal nebee mosu iha kalohan ho rai. Entaun nusaa mak imi la kompriende buat nebee akontese dadauk iha imi nia leet?”
Se iha problema, tenki dame malu
Jesus koalia nafatin dehan, “Nusaa mak imi la hatene hili rasik saida mak loos?

Se ema lori imi ba tribunal, hakaas aan para rezolve tiha imi nia problema molok imi too iha nebaa. Se lae, nia bele obriga imi baa iha juis nia oin, juis entrega ba polisia, i polisia soe imi ba iha kadeia.
Hau hatete ba imi, imi selu kotu tiha multa mak foin bele sai fali husi kadeia.”

footnotes.text: Matenek nain balu kona ba Biblia kompriende versikulu nee hanesan nee: “Imi nia Aman hili imi atu ukun hamutuk ho Nia.” (Haree Lucas 22:30.) Balu kompriende: “Imi nia Aman hili imi atu tama Nia reinu.”
